observations: The real quest receipt Open quests button holds focus during its photograph, pausing its built-in expiry exactly as normal keyboard/controller focus does.
scope: Exact unchanged offline HTML on loopback. Declared level4/house0/earnings-ready farm and a prepared invitation-final-step village, not an earned campaign. Native Gamepad API is mocked; real game/menu/cursor/rules/view methods run. Only renderer/composer draw calls are held between normal-render photographs; deterministic input bursts use the real village tick. Normal photos restore real RAF village ticking. Software Chromium viewport checks do not certify Bluetooth, physical PS5/TV hardware or hardware performance. Focused final delta after the first integrated pass: corrected Fold spacing, exact Create artwork, actual service purchases and display selection, quest Up glyph, real quest reward receipt and Return/movement smoke. Earlier broad input/growth cases remain recorded against their original hash.
